history.title: Custom Category Persistence & Data Consistency
history.summary: Critical bug fixes for custom category persistence, calendar indicators, and data consistency across devices.
features: Custom category creation and cross-device persistence
Direct authenticated Supabase CRUD integration
Custom-category Yellow (#FACC15) calendar workload indicators
Synchronized Add Task and Edit Task dynamic category selection
improvements: Release History and What's New authoritative manifest synchronization
Seamless multi-device custom category discovery from stored tasks and user metadata
performance: Instant targeted DOM updates for task cards and calendar upon database confirmation
fixes: Prevented custom categories from reverting to Personal
Fixed calendar date indicators to properly display custom category Yellow without breaking priority aggregation
Eliminated hung task saves with 10-second timeout guard and database ID verification

history.title: Notification Settings & 10 Custom Notification Sounds
history.summary: Taskly v1.7.0 introduces dedicated Notification Settings with 10 custom chimes, a silent notification mode, a master notifications toggle, and multichannel Android audio routing.
features: Dedicated Notification Settings screen accessible from Profile item 6
10 custom notification chimes bundled locally (Cat Meow, Gentle Chime, Soft Bell, Classic Notification, Digital Pop, Bubble, Glass Tap, Soft Marimba, Calm Melody, and Water Drop)
Master Notifications switch to toggle reminder delivery with pending schedule restoration
Notification Sound switch with dedicated silent channel and vibration preservation
In-app audio preview player to listen to chimes without scheduling alerts
improvements: Multichannel Android notification architecture with dedicated channels per sound
Persistent user notification preferences stored across app restarts
System permission indicator warning if OS-level notification permissions are denied
fixes: Resolved reminder scheduling edge case when editing task deadlines past midnight

history.title: Permanent Release History & What's New System
history.summary: Taskly v1.6.0 introduces an integrated Permanent Release History and interactive What's New feature showcase in Profile → Version, allowing users to browse historical release notes across all 4 themes and compare versions with responsive compact-screen support.
features: Permanent Release History in Profile → Version & Updates tracking all published Taskly versions
Interactive What's New modal showcasing categorized feature highlights and release notes
Historical version switcher with contextual diff comparison banners
One-time post-upgrade display automatically highlighting new features after an update
improvements: Fully responsive What's New layout optimized for compact Android displays down to 320px
Complete multi-theme support across all 4 themes (Light, Dark, Pet, Pastel)
Interactive collapsible history list with quick What's New inspection
fixes: Corrected legacy placeholder text for v1.5.0 historical release notes
security: Two-phase staged release-manifest publishing with atomic file replacement and automatic rollback protection
Pre-publishing schema validation and data loss prevention safeguards

history.summary: Taskly v1.5.0 brings approved Android notification branding with the Cat & Dog logo for system notices, monochrome paw status icon, cute cat mascot deadline alerts, and full in-app APK update capabilities.
features: Approved production release
